TEXLIVE_INSTALL_METHOD.description: How to install texlive. 'libscript_native' uses isolated version dirs, 'system' uses OS package manager, and 'from-source' compiles from source.

TEXLIVE_VERSION.description: Specific version of texlive to install.

TEXLIVE_DOWNLOAD_URL.description: Override URL for downloading texlive binary or archive artifacts.

TEXLIVE_RELEASES_URL.description: Override URL for querying texlive available remote releases.

TEXLIVE_SCHEME.description: TeX Live base scheme installed into the isolated version prefix.

TEXLIVE_EXTRA_PACKAGES.description: Space-separated CTAN packages installed via tlmgr to prevent missing styles or Type-3 bitmap PK fonts.
TEXLIVE_EXTRA_PACKAGES.default: acmart pgfplots pgf booktabs microtype hyperref cm-super libertine
